title: Zuckerberg Claims: Billions of People Will Have Personal AI Assistants Within Five Years, Meta Invests Heavily in the Future
excerpt: Zuckerberg pointed out that such intelligent agents will eventually permeate people's daily lives, deeply assisting users with financial planning, health manage
content_html:
Zuckerberg pointed out that such intelligent agents will eventually permeate people's daily lives, deeply assisting users with financial planning, health management, interpersonal relationships, and everyday home life. As the public gradually begin to interact with multiple intelligent agents, he believes that instant messaging platforms such as WhatsApp will become increasingly critical, and the app is currently the core platform for users to access Meta AI.

Looking across the entire technology industry, major players are all making moves toward intelligent systems that can act on behalf of users to perform tasks. For example, Google introduced customized AI agents as a key highlight in its large-scale search system overhaul; meanwhile, Anthropic's agent-based programming assistant has also gained popularity among engineers.

However, compared to its competitors, Meta, which continues to invest heavily in innovative projects, is facing scrutiny from investors. Financial reports show that the Reality Labs department, responsible for developing hardware and software for AR glasses and VR headsets, once again recorded a loss of about $4.6 billion this quarter. At the same time, due to a significant increase in investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure, the company's free cash flow declined sharply this quarter. To meet the massive computing power demand, the company recently announced plans to build a costly data center in Texas in collaboration with partners.

Despite this, Zuckerberg remains confident that selling intelligent services will offer greater profit margins than simply selling computing power. He believes that these personalized agents currently under development will become the core foundation for the company to launch new products and generate revenue over the next few months to years. Currently, business agents launched for global enterprises have been implemented in multiple communication apps and have been adopted by over a million companies, while the popularization of personal agents for general consumers is also steadily progressing.

content_html_zh:
扎克伯格指出，这样的智能代理最终将渗透到人们的日常生活中，深度协助用户进行财务规划、健康管理、人际关系以及日常家居生活。 随着公众逐渐开始与多种智能代理互动，他认为WhatsApp等即时通讯平台将变得越来越重要，而该应用程序是目前用户访问Meta AI的核心平台。

纵观整个科技行业，主要参与者都在向能够代表用户执行任务的智能系统迈进。 例如，谷歌推出定制化人工智能代理，作为其大规模搜索系统改造的一大亮点；与此同时，Anthropic基于代理的编程助手也受到了工程师的欢迎。

然而，与竞争对手相比，持续大力投资创新项目的Meta正面临投资者的审视。 财报显示，负责开发AR眼镜和VR耳机硬件和软件的Reality Labs部门本季度再次录得约46亿美元的亏损。 与此同时，由于人工智能基础设施投资大幅增加，本季度公司自由现金流大幅下降。 为了满足巨大的计算能力需求，该公司最近宣布计划与合作伙伴合作在德克萨斯州建设一个耗资巨大的数据中心。

尽管如此，扎克伯格仍然相信，销售智能服务将比单纯销售计算能力带来更大的利润率。 他相信目前正在开发的这些个性化代理将成为公司在未来几个月到几年内推出新产品并产生收入的核心基础。 目前，面向全球企业推出的商务座席已在多个通讯应用落地，超过百万家企业采用，面向普通消费者的个人座席普及也在稳步推进。
